title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 8
description: Ten questions on Exodus 8: the frogs, the lice and the swarms of flies that came on Egypt.

questions.text: Who stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt to bring up the frogs?
questions.explanation: Aaron stretched out his hand over the waters of Egypt, and the frogs came up and covered the land.

questions.text: What did the magicians do when the frogs came up?
questions.explanation: The magicians did the same thing with their enchantments and brought up frogs on the land of Egypt.

answers.text: They drove the frogs back to the river

questions.text: What time did Pharaoh set for Moses to pray that the frogs be destroyed?
questions.explanation: Moses gave Pharaoh the honor of setting the time to pray that the frogs be destroyed, and Pharaoh said, "Tomorrow."

questions.text: What happened after the frogs died?
questions.explanation: The people gathered the dead frogs together in heaps, and the land stank.

answers.text: They were thrown into the sea
They came back to life in the river
They were eaten by the birds
They were gathered in heaps and the land stank

questions.text: What did Aaron strike to bring the lice?
questions.explanation: Aaron stretched out his rod and struck the dust of the earth, and all the dust became lice throughout Egypt.

questions.text: What did the magicians say to Pharaoh when they could not produce lice?
questions.explanation: The magicians said to Pharaoh, "This is God's finger," but Pharaoh's heart was hardened.

questions.text: Which land did Yahweh set apart so that no swarms of flies would be there?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would set apart the land of Goshen, where his people lived, so that no swarms of flies would be there.

questions.text: What did Pharaoh first offer after the swarms of flies came?
questions.explanation: Pharaoh said, "Go, sacrifice to your God in the land!"

answers.text: To let them go for three days' journey
To give them back their straw
To let them sacrifice to their God in the land

questions.text: Why did Moses say they could not sacrifice in the land of Egypt?
questions.explanation: Moses said they would sacrifice what was an abomination to the Egyptians, who might stone them for it.

answers.text: The Egyptians might stone them for their sacrifice
They had no animals to sacrifice
Their priests were in the wilderness
The land was full of frogs

questions.text: How many swarms of flies remained after Yahweh removed them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh removed the swarms of flies from Pharaoh, his servants and his people. There remained not one.
